blocks.text: Sitting at an old wooden front desk is an old blind woman with a gypsy headscarf knitting and humming the tune “Für Elise”.

It somehow makes you think of the fable Jack and the Beanstalk, the words “Fe, Fi, Fo, Fum. I smell the blood of an Englishman, Be he alive, or be he dead, I'll grind up his bones to make my bread” echoing in your head.
She asks if you have payment.
